purpose: Test one bounded direct-I2S tone with the official GPIO30 playback-enable sequence without changing reusable audio or Doom.
runtime_blockers: The source has no one-shot execution authorization, build evidence, frozen verifier, capture transport, or hardware result.

GPIO30 high shuts down populated U4 and requests the optional Q10/NS4168 path off if its not-fitted parts are populated; GPIO30 low follows the official factory playback request and may enable that optional path only if populated.
The candidate direct amplifiers use unswitched VDD5; LDO3/LDO4 ownership is not claimed to switch their power.
Reusable platform audio, Doom audio, board-wide audio, app-only flash, and full-project flash remain unauthorized.
